description: Current and planned bus disruptions in Great Britain from the Bus Open Data Service (SIRI-SX): diversions, closed stops, roadworks and events, each with the operators and lines affected and the stops named. Filter by operator code (NOC) or by a word matched against the text, e.g. a town, road or line. Rail incidents are the separate 'disruptions' tool.

operatorCode.description: Operator NOC code, e.g. 'FLDS' for First Leeds.

query.description: Words to match in the disruption, e.g. 'Leeds', 'A61', 'line 36'.

name: bus_disruptions
title: Bus disruptions
